title: Insulin Pump Program Denial Code Matrix and Appeal Windows
content:
On the Insulin Pump Program a denial is worked by its denial code, and the code alone decides the route; the self-pay tier has no denials or appeals.

## Matrix

| Denial code | Meaning | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| CO-16 | claim lacks information | Unprocessable and never appealed; cured only by a corrected claim transmitted no later than the tier's corrected-claim window in calendar days after the denial's posting date |
| CO-50 | not medically necessary | Appealable |
| CO-151 | frequency or quantity not supported | Appealable only when a medical record supporting the quantity, dated on or before the date of service, is on file; otherwise not appealed and handled as a non-covered amount under the advance-notice-of-liability rules |
| CO-197 | authorization absent | Appealable only when an authorization grant valid on the date of service is on file; otherwise not appealed and handled as a non-covered amount under the advance-notice-of-liability rules |
| CO-29 | timely filing expired | Never appealed and never billed to the customer; Larkfield writes it off with a billing-correction adjustment |
| PR-204 | not covered under the plan | Becomes the customer's responsibility only under the advance-notice-of-liability rules; otherwise Larkfield absorbs it |

## Appeal levels

1. **First level.** A first-level appeal may be filed no later than the tier's first-level appeal window in calendar days after the posting date of the denial it appeals, counted in calendar days from that posting date with the last day allowed.
2. **Upheld decisions.** An appeal decision that upholds the denial posts as a new denial whose original posting is the appeal filing.
3. **Second level.** A second-level appeal may be filed only against such an upheld first-level decision, no later than the tier's second-level appeal window in calendar days after its posting date. Where that window is 0 there is no customer-filed second level on the tier, and on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan forwards an upheld denial to the independent review entity itself.
4. **One appeal per level.** One appeal is filed per level per denial; a denial already appealed at a level is not appealed again at that level.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; 60-day first-level window, denial posted on day P)

| Filing date | First-level appeal |
|---|---|
| day P plus 60 | May be filed |
| day P plus 61 | Outside the window |
| day P plus 20, a first-level appeal of this denial already filed | Not filed again |
